body:
归档 Final Sprint 审计、BTC→ETH Stage 1 / Stage 2A 诊断，并交付基于同一冻结真实行情的交互式 Visual EDA。研究仍停留在探索阶段，不进入正式预测回测或交易策略开发。

## 审阅入口

- [研究总入口](https://github.com/BouillieAnonymous/Perpetual-Alpha-2026/blob/7322df45a1d057a304794c6739a204a94cd12e33/docs/research/btc-eth-volatility/README.md)
- [Visual EDA 使用与复现说明](https://github.com/BouillieAnonymous/Perpetual-Alpha-2026/blob/7322df45a1d057a304794c6739a204a94cd12e33/docs/research/btc-eth-volatility/visual-eda/README.md)
- [图像观察报告](https://github.com/BouillieAnonymous/Perpetual-Alpha-2026/blob/7322df45a1d057a304794c6739a204a94cd12e33/docs/research/btc-eth-volatility/visual-eda/output-reviewed/observations.md)
- [五类 PNG 与离线 Dashboard 目录](https://github.com/BouillieAnonymous/Perpetual-Alpha-2026/tree/7322df45a1d057a304794c6739a204a94cd12e33/docs/research/btc-eth-volatility/visual-eda/output-reviewed)
- 交付及人工验收：#37（保持 open，待真实浏览器和研究者验收）

Dashboard 为自包含离线 HTML。下载或克隆本 PR 分支，双击 `docs/research/btc-eth-volatility/visual-eda/output-reviewed/dashboard.html` 在浏览器打开；GitHub 源代码预览不会执行图表。支持 UTC 范围输入、拖动缩放、悬停、BTC/ETH及A/B切换，并提供三个推荐观察时段。

## 新增 Visual EDA

固定样本：2026-10-19 13:43—2026-11-03 10:00 UTC，21,378决策点；来源 hyperliquid-testnet/pas，原库序号上界457619。只使用本地Stage 1冻结 BTC/ETH export/panel，无新采集、外部行情或合成替代。A保留新有效事件零收益；B为Strict active-quote敏感性。

五类图分别展示共同起点标准化价格、有符号分钟收益与质量标记、5/15/30/60分钟完整窗口RV、正负BTC冲击后的ETH有符号结果分布、spread/报价年龄/缺失窗/共同覆盖率。缺失不补零、不插值，不以异步REST报价冒充同步成交。

事件阈值在计算前按开发段有符号BTC收益Q05/Q95固定，没有搜索最盈利阈值。共2,181事件、179重叠连通簇；完整保留缺失计数与各期限缺失原因，事件入选不依赖ETH未来标签。簇也不保证独立。该历史已被研究者观察，不能再称干净样本外。

## 已有 Stage 1 / Stage 2A 结果

Stage 1基线为8c00ec8。A/B在B的2,335个共同完整H1时点，BTC过去15分钟RV、ETH过去15分钟RV、ETH未来30分钟RV数值完全相等，整体差异来自样本选择。控制ETH自身波动后的BTC增量弱且对采样间隔/分段敏感。A半小时历史验证MSE改善2.03%，末段恶化0.63%；B非重叠样本不足，时序比较为INSUFFICIENT DATA。不计算显著性，不支持已验证Alpha或可交易盈利结论。

原Stage 1 / Stage 2A报告、protocol及冻结统计完整保留；本次未覆盖。Final Sprint只代表当时运维快照。

## 验证与待验收

- [x] 冻结raw/panel SHA256核对、42,756资产分钟点A/B收益及所选seq逐点复现
- [x] 全部16组Stage 1 RV窗口数量复现
- [x] 独立核对全部6,543个事件结果/缺失原因、事件资格与重叠簇
- [x] 13时序面板及事件图DOM/Canvas mock：UTC范围、悬停、曲线切换、拖动缩放、reset、无网络依赖
- [x] 五份PNG目视检查；发布文件Ruff与diff检查；16份Git blob证据指纹一致
- [ ] 真实浏览器端到端验收（mock不替代）
- [ ] 研究者检查图像并记录接受/修订意见（#37）
- [ ] 当前提交GitHub容器CI：以Checks实时状态为准

Stage 2A既有验证还包括独立正规方程验证21组OLS、4组427行配对预测误差；这些与本次EDA验证分开归属。

## 交付与安全边界

仅提交EDA工具、核验产物及研究导航。冻结原始公共行情缓存不上传，完整重算需另行提供相同SHA256缓存；缓存缺失即阻断。没有钱包/API/SMTP秘密、生产服务或配置变更；没有账户操作、签名交易、合并或部署。不自动运行下一阶段检验、训练、策略回测或参数搜索。

最新EDA提交：`7322df45a1d057a304794c6739a204a94cd12e33`。

- 原 comparison.csv 的170项名单、状态与37项正收益筛选逐行锁定；保留规则版本、参数、多空目标和旧仓位/成交记录。3对 Z/Bollinger 结构等价，随机对照不当作Alpha。

- 原133项非正/无信号组合的长期对照为127负、6正；没有用这些事后正值替换原37项或扩展参数。
- 1751组主实验+141组排除PAR筛选期的诊断，共1892账本；包括60/20/20时间分区、自然月、趋势/震荡、固定多/空/空仓及匹配仓位方向基准。价差、滑点、手续费、价格、Funding代理、换手、回撤和资本占用独立报告。

基于PR #15提交6832145的独立、堆叠研究PR，base为codex/new-alpha-discovery-report；不覆盖原研究结果，不包含运行时策略启用。

### 核心结果
- 复用10资产×17固定规则与原生/HIP-3自身价格、Funding；四状态固定为25h价格效率趋势/震荡×RV24相对过去168个RV中位数的高/低波动，没有阈值搜索或新数据API。
- 全段680条件单元：118个小时归因净正，但状态为415 INSUFFICIENT_DATA、22 INCONCLUSIVE、243 REJECTED。等价规则、共享资产与持仓依赖不当作独立证据。
- 两项描述性线索在三个顺序分段都正：HYPE/EMA/TREND_HIGH（归因+3.718%，低于同状态固定多头+7.059%）；HYPE/SIMPLE_MR/RANGE_HIGH（归因+7.638%，后两段仅15/19完整持仓）。均是事后归因，不是可成交过滤收益；未事后加入选择器。
- 事前只允许TSM、ATR、ROLLING_Z及FLAT；60d训练、14d验证、两侧12h隔离、五段14d滚动评估和锁定28d。720训练尝试中25达到最低独立持仓/天数，只有3个训练净正，0个区间下界高于零；240映射均FLAT，选择器0成交，结论INSUFFICIENT_DATA。
- 三个预定义过滤器均未盈利：70d滚动TSM −1.356%、ATR −0.092%、Z −2.901%；锁定28d分别−0.596%、−0.813%、−1.458%。减亏不等于相对空仓的正Alpha。
- 1200离线成本情景重放；完整价格/费用/价差/滑点/Funding、换手、资本占用、独立持仓、自然月、逐段与组合DD/日波动、切换次数、基准与配对区间均归档。增量成本差额不冒称纯切换成本。
- 全部历史已由PR #15看过；本轮留出仅为算法时间隔离，全部Retrospective，不冒充真正独立前瞻。没有证据支持当前开发运行时Selector或增加ML复杂度。

body:
Tests whether oracle-basis deviations predict profitable price direction, rather than assuming convergence or a five-minute hold is sufficient. Adds independent offline convergence and direction studies; no trading strategy is enabled or reversed, and no stop/take-profit parameters are selected. Keep draft.

Reports:
- [Direction, matched execution, MAE/MFE and official-history audit](https://github.com/BouillieAnonymous/Perpetual-Alpha-2026/blob/codex/reference-basis-research/docs/research/basis-direction-2026-10-17/report.zh-CN.md)
- [Convergence / breakeven / profit-target first-passage study](https://github.com/BouillieAnonymous/Perpetual-Alpha-2026/blob/codex/reference-basis-research/docs/research/basis-convergence-2026-10-17/report.zh-CN.md)

Data and implementation:
- Frozen 50,050 real BTC/ETH testnet snapshots; 50,044 valid rows, six invalid reference-time rows and 44 continuity breaks. Raw data stays local; archived event/observation evidence, complete CSVs, hashes and PNG/SVG figures are included.
- Episodes require a prior observed reset; repeated snapshots within one deviation are not independent onsets. Convergence study: 10/20/50 bps triggers, +/-2/5 bps bands, 1/3/5/10/30/60 minute horizons, explicit censoring, KM counts/bounds and exploratory date-block intervals.
- Direction audit uses frozen onsets without selecting successful convergences, +/-2 bps reset only. Separates signal-origin from next-quote-origin forward returns, signed-basis IC from magnitude/payoff correlation, and mid moves from tradable bid/ask payoffs.
- Original, opposite, always-long and always-short comparisons use the same events/quotes/quantity and require both sides' entry/exit depth in the paired cohort. Opposite net PnL is computed from its own bid/ask, never a negation. No trade is the zero baseline. Full distributions, per-day results, leave-one-day-out/outlier sensitivity and sampled MAE/MFE are archived.
- Actual official read-only requests obtained 217 hourly fundingHistory records per asset (434 total), complete requested hour buckets. Signed historical-rate funding cashflow uses the last eligible local oracle as a settlement-value approximation, not actual account payments or historical input availability.
- Official recentTrades returned 10 per asset; only three BTC trades overlap the frozen local window, none for ETH. Retain only market fields, omit participant lists. An unsigned HEAD of the documented S3 asset-context object returned 403; testnet/par archive existence/coverage remains unconfirmed. No candles downloaded, credentials loaded or requester-pays download performed.
- Correct prior prototype defaults to 9 bps taker/side, BTC/ETH quantity step 0.0001 and minimum entry value 10. Account-specific historical fees/rules remain unverified.
- The branch also contains a separately committed collector poll configuration change from 30s to 5s. This analysis still uses the frozen approximately 30s sample; no newer collected prices are passed off as fresh validation. This research task did not deploy or change server services.

Main directional findings (>=20 bps onsets):
- From the next quote, 5m outcomes are available for 179 episodes: 122 original-direction moves, 38 opposite moves, 19 flat. Original hit rate 68.2%; signed-basis/forward-mid Pearson -0.329, Spearman -0.378. Association favors reversion in seen data, not a direction-mapping bug.
- Absolute initial deviation vs favorable 5m move has Pearson +0.098 and an exploratory date-block interval crossing zero; larger deviations are not proven more profitable.
- Only 17 episodes have retained signals and paired entry/exit depth at 5m. Original ideal mid movement +8.83 bps becomes -0.05 bps at executable touch quotes, then -22.10 bps after costs; opposite net is -39.76 bps. Original net-positive exits 3/17, opposite 0/17. Official funding-rate scenario: -22.05/-39.71 bps.
- Original/reverse paired mean net is negative at every studied horizon. Leave-one-day-out and largest-move diagnostics do not turn the directional association into a positive-cost strategy.
- Paired 5m sampled net MAE medians are -28.42/-45.65 bps; MFE medians zero. Unclamped best net value is separately retained so MFE=0 is not misrepresented as an observed breakeven exit.
- Earlier convergence result remains: 180 onsets, 10m/60m KM convergence 55.8%/88.4%, median 8.22m. Financial/price cohorts and time origins differ; do not combine their denominators or PnL means.

Validation: 62 basis/cost/convergence/direction tests; with existing forecast architecture/adapter/interfaces, 112 relevant tests pass. Ruff, diff and evidence/method/official hashes pass. All 810 direction group point summaries exactly reproduced from 9,985 archived observations; figures visually checked. Existing Windows Paper full-suite process-exit limitation remains; full regression is not claimed green. Linux CI runs separately.

All Oct 8-17 prices have already been seen. These are sampled retrospective associations/opportunities, not guaranteed fills, account returns, causal proof, fresh out-of-sample validation or hedged arbitrage. No merge or deployment.

body:
Generalizes PR #13's existing convergence and matched-direction studies rather than replacing them. Per-market metadata supplies quantity precision; unverified valuation disables PnL. A clearly labeled legacy BTC/ETH linear scenario preserves comparability without claiming reliable valuation for the other markets.

Stacked on PR #13 (base codex/reference-basis-research, including its latest parallel configuration change). Independent of collector PR #16; no production strategy integration.

- Reuses episode reset/onset rules, censoring/KM, next-quote rechecks, actual bid/ask and conservative top-level depth checks, independent original/opposite fills, costs, Oracle/Basis attribution, MAE/MFE and breakeven/profit first passages.
- Adds asset/session/calendar/past-only volatility comparisons and price-precision eligibility. Different input/connection domains break continuity; no candle-generated books or out-of-sample claims.
- Archives all public reproducibility inputs: 50,050 frozen snapshots, 30,622 newly exported VPS rows, 2,061 local stream observations, official metadata, ten-market hourly funding/recent-trade evidence. Raw gzip inputs, per-asset reports, full compressed results, comparison CSV, figures, and cross-platform hashes included.
- BTC/ETH 20bps-onset five-minute matched scenarios: n=7/11, mean original net -26.17/-13.92 bps; opposite net -37.71/-45.71 bps. Eight other markets have only minutes of data and unverified valuation: insufficient evidence, no invented PnL or positive-expectation claim.
- 121 targeted research/architecture/interface tests passed; Ruff/diff checks and committed artifact/source hashes verified. Full Windows suite is not claimed.

body:
Integrates the Funding-LAST runner onto current main while preserving the PAS Collector, Research Pipeline and standalone CSV export. Adds isolated PAS deployment configuration, separate-purpose leverage/trading approval checks, a public monitor and durable alert outbox.

Strategy and risk settings remain frozen: ETH Funding-LAST, maximum 25 USDP target/order notional, 1x Cross target, normal UTC 00:00/12:00 decision windows, no PAS bootstrap. Existing execution friction, collateral scope and exchange fill/position reconciliation gates remain in force. Pause/stop does not automatically flatten positions.

Synchronized with latest main; all three required CI jobs passed on the tested head. Marked Ready and merged. Prior regression and container acceptance reused; no additional strategy research or architecture changes. [Passing CI](https://github.com/BouillieAnonymous/Perpetual-Alpha-2026/actions/runs/39338241131).

Detailed operational evidence is maintained separately from this code review. Private credentials and operational approvals are not committed to the repository.
